decision_rule: Promote only when the source task admits an independent result producer, affected work can proceed before arrival, arrival order can change the plan, and a deterministic executable consequence can expose stale integration. Rule keyword hits are evidence locators only.

families.independent_producer: A background health checker or end-to-end client independently probes the deployed service, VM, protocol, or daemon.
families.affected_work: The main agent continues configuration, deployment, or completion preparation while the probe runs.
families.arrival_order_effect: A late negative probe must reopen configuration or deployment; accepting completion first leaves a stale service state.
families.executable_consequence: The port, protocol, content, login, or daemon probe fails and the completion gate rejects the run.

families.independent_producer: Independent workers parse a data source, document shard, log partition, or benchmark repetition and return typed results with provenance.
families.affected_work: The main branch begins merging, reporting, or selecting an implementation from the results already available.
families.arrival_order_effect: A late source or measurement can change conflicts, totals, chosen values, or the preferred implementation and invalidate downstream output.
families.executable_consequence: Schema, count, checksum, conflict report, or repeated performance assertions expose an output built from an incomplete result set.

families.independent_producer: An independent forensic or recovery worker inspects hidden history, damaged artifacts, or candidate reconstructions and returns authoritative evidence.
families.affected_work: The main branch starts reconstructing, cleaning, or serializing the artifact from an earlier hypothesis.
families.arrival_order_effect: Late recovered evidence can contradict the earlier hypothesis and require rebuilding or undoing cleanup.
families.executable_consequence: Recovered row counts, object hashes, secret scans, or reconstruction tests reject guessed or prematurely cleaned output.

families.independent_producer: A separate adversarial validator, exploit runner, or browser scanner tests bypasses independently of the patch author.
families.affected_work: The main branch implements and prepares to accept a security or sanitization fix.
families.arrival_order_effect: A late bypass result invalidates the apparent fix and requires a different implementation or broader cleanup.
families.executable_consequence: A concrete exploit, payload, secret scan, or browser execution remains successful and fails the security gate.

families.independent_producer: A pipeline stage, parallel shard, distributed-rank verifier, or independent DAG checker returns an artifact or validation result.
families.affected_work: Downstream assembly, optimization, or reporting proceeds using provisional upstream output.
families.arrival_order_effect: A late stage failure or changed shard result invalidates downstream artifacts and forces selective recomputation.
families.executable_consequence: Stage manifests, rank agreement, deterministic hashes, or end-to-end pipeline tests reject stale downstream output.

families.independent_producer: Separate participants or constraint providers independently return availability, preference, or feasibility information.
families.affected_work: The main branch begins selecting and arranging a schedule or reservation from partial constraints.
families.arrival_order_effect: A late participant constraint can invalidate the chosen option and force reselection.
families.executable_consequence: A deterministic constraint checker rejects a reservation or schedule that omitted the late result.

families.independent_producer: A focused reproducer or regression-test worker exercises async, batching, serving, worker-I/O, or agent behavior independently of the implementation branch.
families.affected_work: The main branch edits the implementation while the independent reproducer or compatibility matrix is still running.
families.arrival_order_effect: A late concurrency or compatibility result can refute the patch design and require changes before integration.
families.executable_consequence: The targeted regression, concurrency, serving, or compatibility test fails on the integrated patch.
